title: KCP byom_episode_binding_show result
description: CommandResult.result payload (§11.2 ok arm): the realm's ByomEpisodeBinding rows, each carrying both fences.

displayName.description: Display name bounded by the §11.8 cap of 256 Unicode scalar values, length-bounded again at admission.

stable_binding_key.description: L22 idempotent-create key: an exact retry returns the identical row, and UNIQUE(episode_ref, byom_attempt_ref, kovee_invocation_ref) makes a different key for the same triple conflict instead of double-binding.

byom_attempt_ref.description: The exact EpisodeAttempt. Its lifecycle is byom's (spec/descriptors/episode.json) — referenced here, never re-owned.

byom_fence_epoch.description: One of the DUAL fences every runtime mutation must present (family contract L21/R30).

kovee_invocation_fence.description: The other of the DUAL fences. A mutation carrying only one fence is invalid; either fence advancing invalidates the binding for every further mutation.

state.description: ByomEpisodeBinding state (spec/descriptors/byom-episode-binding.json). fenced and released are terminal; a fenced row is RETAINED for audit and orphan-result diagnostics — a stale worker keeps bytes as local evidence but cannot advance any head.

fenced_reason.description: Which fence advanced, recorded for the audit closure.

record.description: The ByomEpisodeBinding record, byom §16.6 item 3 field list verbatim plus the four recorded-gap field groups.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

statusToken.description: Lower-snake status token; the Episode lifecycle itself is byom-owned (spec/descriptors/episode.json).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
